items.name: utils
items.title: Utils
items.description: cn() and cnState(), which merges classes into a UI SDK className that may be a function of state.

items.name: theme
items.title: Theme
items.description: Semantic color tokens plus shape, density and surface tokens. The default look: rounded, roomy, soft shadows.
items.docs: Add `@layer ui-sdk;` as the first line of your global stylesheet, above `@import "tailwindcss"`, so your styles win over UI SDK's behavior CSS.

items.name: theme-compact
items.title: Compact theme
items.description: Denser controls, tighter radii and padding. Applies inside any element with data-theme="compact". Also holds AgentTaskBoard's density: compact shape and spacing under data-density="compact", or data-density="auto" while the board is 75rem wide or less.

items.name: theme-glass
items.title: Glass theme
items.description: Translucent, blurred surfaces. Applies inside any element with data-theme="glass"; tune it with --glass-opacity and --glass-blur.

items.name: appearance
items.title: Appearance
items.description: createAppearance and <Appearance>: keep the .dark class and data-theme on <html> in sync with a color scheme (system follows prefers-color-scheme live, or light or dark) and a theme, optionally saved between visits. Works in a static file:// page.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: UI SDK Button with variants: async pending state, focusable-when-disabled, link rendering.

items.name: field
items.title: Field
items.description: UI SDK Field parts: label, description and validation errors wired to the control.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: UI SDK Input, InputGroup and InputClear (clears and returns focus).

items.name: search-field
items.title: Search Field
items.description: Search landmark built with definePrimitive: Enter runs onSearch, Escape clears only when there is text, and agents get a submit action.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: UI SDK Dialog parts: focus trap, Escape, focus restore, dismissible and controller support.

items.name: confirm-dialog
items.title: Confirm Dialog
items.description: UI SDK AlertDialog with an async confirm action: pending, no double submit, closes on success, inline error on failure, data-agent-confirm for destructive actions.

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: Presentational card parts rendered with UI SDK renderElement (render prop, server-safe).

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: Presentational badge with semantic variants (success, warning, info, destructive).

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: UI SDK Tabs: arrow-key navigation, automatic or manual activation, controller support, and a selected state that reads at 3:1.

items.name: collapsible
items.title: Collapsible
items.description: UI SDK Collapsible: disclosure with aria-expanded, animated height, controller support and a rotating chevron icon.

items.name: scroll-area
items.title: Scroll Area
items.description: UI SDK ScrollArea: native scrolling with styled scrollbars, edge state and follow-to-end, keyboard-reachable when it overflows.

items.name: separator
items.title: Separator
items.description: UI SDK Separator: horizontal or vertical, announced or decorative.

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: UI SDK Avatar with sizes: a real img that falls back to initials while loading or on error.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: Presentational loading placeholder, hidden from assistive technology, that stops pulsing under reduced motion.

items.name: empty
items.title: Empty
items.description: Presentational empty-state parts: media, title, description and actions.

items.name: kbd
items.title: Kbd
items.description: Presentational keyboard key and key group rendered as kbd.

items.name: table
items.title: Table
items.description: Semantic table parts with truncating cells, aria-sort-ready headers and a horizontal scroll area on narrow screens.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: UI SDK Tooltip parts: names or describes its trigger, opens on hover and keyboard focus, Escape closes it, optional shortcut and arrow.

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: UI SDK Popover parts on a glass-ready surface: focus moves in, Escape and outside presses close it, focus returns to the trigger.

items.name: drawer
items.title: Drawer
items.description: UI SDK Drawer parts: a modal sheet from any edge (bottom or side), draggable, with focus trap, Escape and focus restore.

items.name: dropdown-menu
items.title: Dropdown Menu
items.description: UI SDK Menu parts with a button trigger: arrow keys, typeahead, checkbox and radio items, submenus, destructive items and async actions.

items.name: toast
items.title: Toast
items.description: UI SDK toasts: ToastStack renders a styled, announced region; toast() and createToaster() add toasts with actions, cancel and timed dismissal.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: UI SDK Select: trigger, popup list, items with a check indicator, groups and separators. Works inside Field; agents choose by label.

items.name: combobox
items.title: Combobox
items.description: UI SDK Combobox: a filtering input with clear and trigger buttons and a popup list. Works inside Field; agents choose by label.

items.name: segmented-control
items.title: Segmented Control
items.description: UI SDK SegmentedControl: one choice from a row of buttons with a sliding indicator, like a board/table view switch.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: UI SDK Checkbox and CheckboxGroup: checked, unchecked and indeterminate, labelled by Field.

items.name: textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.description: UI SDK Textarea: multi-line field with auto resize and a submit shortcut, labelled by Field.

items.name: quantity
items.title: Quantity
items.description: Honest values: formatQuantity() and QuantityValue show unknown as a dash, estimated with ~ and screen reader text, and the source in the title.

items.name: relative-time
items.title: Relative Time
items.description: formatRelative() and formatInstant() on Date + Intl, a RelativeTime <time> with the absolute instant in its title, and a useNow hook that pauses while the page is hidden.

items.name: acceptance-list
items.title: Acceptance List
items.description: A list of pass, fail and unverified criteria with evidence, and a segmented AcceptanceBar on the UI SDK Meter with an accessible summary.

items.name: stat
items.title: Stat
items.description: Summary figures: Stat, StatLabel, StatValue (a number, a Quantity or a node) and StatHint, in a responsive StatGroup list.

items.name: board
items.title: Board
items.description: Generic kanban layout: a named, horizontally scrolling list of columns with headers, counts, actions, collapsible columns agents can toggle by name, groups and an empty slot.

items.name: status-pill
items.title: Status Pill
items.description: Presentational status pill with semantic tones and an optional dot that can pulse; the pulse stops under reduced motion.

items.name: dependency-chips
items.title: Dependency Chips
items.description: A named list of toned chips that truncate long labels, collapse past max into a +N chip, and become UI SDK Buttons agents can press when onSelect is set.

items.name: agent-task-types
items.title: Agent task types
items.description: TaskView, AttemptView, AgentRef, UsageSummary and ThreadRef: the data contract of the agent task components, plus effectiveAgent and agentDiffers.

items.name: agent-badge
items.title: Agent Badge
items.description: Provider, model and effort of an AgentRef: compact for cards (one line, long model ids cut in the middle, full text in title) or detail for panels, with a marker when the agent that ran isn't the one requested.

items.name: liveness-indicator
items.title: Liveness Indicator
items.description: A toned dot and label for an agent's computed liveness (running pulses, suspect_dead is destructive) and the time since its last activity, with now, locale and timeZone passed through.

items.name: task-status
items.title: Task Status
items.description: TaskStatusPill, AttemptStatusPill and ContextModePill: StatusPill tones and overridable labels for agent task, attempt and context mode values, with the source thread for reuse and fork.

items.name: usage
items.title: Usage
items.description: Token, time and cost usage of an agent task: UsageStat for a card and UsageTable on Table, with compact counts, the exact value in the title, honest unknown and estimated values, and summaries side by side as columns.

items.name: attempt-timeline
items.title: Attempt Timeline
items.description: An agent task's attempts on the UI SDK Timeline: kind, status, times, configured and executed route with earlier routes in a popover, context, repairs, checks, commits, blockers, thread links agents can press, usage per attempt and older attempts behind a toggle.

items.name: agent-task-board-core
items.title: Agent Task Board core
items.description: The non-visual core of AgentTaskBoard: filter, group, sort and summarize tasks; English and Spanish labels; and the board and proposals primitives whose agent actions select, filter, switch views, open threads and decide proposals.

items.name: proposal-actions
items.title: Proposal Actions
items.description: Approve and Reject for one task proposal: async pending with no double submit, inline errors, an on-screen reject confirmation, and agent access set by agentApproval (confirm, allow or deny). Renders nothing in snapshot mode.

items.name: task-card
items.title: Task Card
items.description: A compact agent task card: id, two-line title, profile, active agent, liveness, acceptance bar, attempts and cost, dependency chips, blocker with its retry time, decision and analysis-mode markers, and proposal actions in live mode. A stretched UI SDK Button selects it without nesting other controls.

items.name: task-detail-panel
items.title: Task Detail Panel
items.description: An agent task's goal, acceptance and evidence, dependencies that select their task, the pending decision with proposal actions, usage and the attempt timeline. TaskDetailPanel shows it as a non-modal panel; TaskDetailDialog as a modal dialog or a right-side drawer. Escape and a close button close either.

items.name: agent-task-board
items.title: Agent Task Board
items.description: The full board for AI agent tasks: filters, search, a board or sortable table view, a summary, collapsible status columns with ready and waiting groups, a detail dialog, drawer or side panel, compact density on narrow hosts, snapshot and live modes, English and Spanish labels, and agent actions to select, filter, switch views, open threads and decide proposals.

items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: UI SDK Accordion parts: triggers in headings, Enter and Space toggle, animated panels on the density tokens.

items.name: hover-card
items.title: Hover Card
items.description: UI SDK Hover Card on the popover surface: a link that previews where it goes on hover or keyboard focus.

items.name: context-menu
items.title: Context Menu
items.description: UI SDK Menu opened by right-click, long press or Shift+F10 on a focusable area, with the dropdown menu's items.

items.name: menubar
items.title: Menubar
items.description: UI SDK Menubar: one tab stop, arrow keys between menus, with the dropdown menu's surface and items.

items.name: navigation-menu
items.title: Navigation Menu
items.description: UI SDK Navigation Menu: a named landmark of triggers that disclose panels of links, each panel on the popover surface.

items.name: breadcrumb
items.title: Breadcrumb
items.description: Presentational breadcrumb trail: a navigation named Breadcrumb, an ordered list and aria-current on the current page.

items.name: pagination
items.title: Pagination
items.description: UI SDK Pagination that works standalone: page, pageCount or total and pageSize, onPageChange with details, overridable labels.

items.name: command
items.title: Command
items.description: UI SDK Command list with search, groups, empty state and Kbd shortcuts, plus a CommandDialog palette with an opt-in mod+K trigger.

items.name: radio-group
items.title: Radio Group
items.description: UI SDK RadioGroup and Radio: pick one with arrow keys, named by Field.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: UI SDK Switch with its thumb: an on/off setting that sits in a row beside its Field label.

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: UI SDK Slider: one value or a range, with a formatted value part, named by Field.

items.name: toggle
items.title: Toggle
items.description: UI SDK Toggle: a button that stays pressed, with variants and sizes.

items.name: toggle-group
items.title: Toggle Group
items.description: UI SDK ToggleGroup: toggles sharing one value with arrow-key focus, named by Field.

items.name: otp-input
items.title: OTP Input
items.description: UI SDK OTPInput: one native input shown as slots, with paste and one-time-code autofill.

items.name: number-input
items.title: Number Input
items.description: UI SDK NumberInput: typed, stepped and formatted numbers with step buttons, named by Field.

items.name: label
items.title: Label
items.description: UI SDK Label: names any control by htmlFor, including a radio group, slider or switch.

items.name: progress
items.title: Progress
items.description: UI SDK Progress: a task's progress, determinate or indeterminate, with label and value.

items.name: meter
items.title: Meter
items.description: UI SDK Meter: a reading within a known range, like storage used.

items.name: alert
items.title: Alert
items.description: Presentational alert with tones (info, success, warning, destructive); role=alert only when asked.

items.name: calendar
items.title: Calendar
items.description: UI SDK Calendar: a month grid with arrow, Page Up/Down and Home/End keys, single, multiple or range selection, several months, min/max and unavailable dates, locale and timeZone.

items.name: date-picker
items.title: Date Picker
items.description: UI SDK Date Picker: type a date in the locale's format or pick it from a calendar popup, single or range, with a format hint, an optional clear button and ISO values.

items.name: carousel
items.title: Carousel
items.description: UI SDK Carousel: native scroll-snap slides with Previous and Next, arrow keys, indicators and optional rotation; agents page it by name.

items.name: resizable
items.title: Resizable
items.description: UI SDK Resizable: panels with named separator handles that move with the pointer or arrow keys, collapse with Enter and can save their layout.

items.name: sidebar
items.title: Sidebar
items.description: App navigation: a named landmark with groups and items (href or a router link), the current page marked with aria-current, collapsing to an icon rail with tooltips and opening in a drawer on narrow screens. Agents collapse and expand it by name.

items.name: data-table
items.title: Data Table
items.description: Generic typed table: sortable columns with aria-sort, optional row selection with a mixed select-all, loading and empty states, and pagination through renderPagination. Sort, selection and page are controlled or not, and agents can sort, select and page it.

items.name: page-header
items.title: Page Header
items.description: Presentational page header: a title at the heading level you choose, a description, an actions slot and an optional breadcrumb slot.

items.name: filter-bar
items.title: Filter Bar
items.description: A UI SDK Toolbar of filters with one tab stop and arrow keys, a search field inside it, and a reset button that shows while filters apply.

items.name: chart
items.title: Chart
items.description: Recharts v3 composed with Eskais tokens: ChartContainer maps a config to --color-<key> variables (light and dark), popover tooltips and legends, and ChartDataTable renders the same data as a table for screen readers and agents. The container is a figure that requires a name.

items.name: lint-rules
items.title: Lint Rules (optional)
items.description: Optional oxlint config with @shadcn/lint design-system rules for Eskais UI consumers. Extend it from your .oxlintrc.json.
